purpose: Teach: 鉄砲/小作/扮/バルブ/チタン/引き寄せ/押し上げ/小国

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気for、絶対、鉄砲、絶対、所持、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're handling this case seriously. I can assure you the police investigation is proceeding with full commitment.
lines.style: Measured and professional. Steady voice throughout. Careful enunciation on the commitment words. Even pacing—bureaucratic precision without coldness. A promise, not a reassurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地方の、本気で、絶対、小作、絶対、争議、絶対、歴史、絶対、警察、絶対、関連資料、絶対、お持ちですか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Do you have any police records or materials related to the local labor disputes from that historical period?
lines.style: Tentative, genuinely curious. Leans forward slightly into the question. Respectful hesitation before asking—he knows he's asking for something. Slight lift at the end, not demanding, inviting.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者、本気で、絶対、他人に、絶対、扮、絶対、して、絶対、犯行、絶対、警察、絶対、見抜きました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We were able to identify that the suspect was impersonating someone else. The police investigation saw through that deception.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. Slight emphasis on 'saw through'—a small note of professional competence. Steady eye contact. No embellishment, just the facts laid out clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 工場の、本気で、絶対、バルブ、絶対、不正改造、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the police did investigate the illegal valve modifications at the factory, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, piecing things together. Soft confirmation-seeking tone, not interrogative. Speaking half to himself, half to the officer. Gentle downward inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。盗品の、本気で、絶対、チタン、絶対、製、絶対、貴金属、絶対、警察、絶対、追跡しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently tracking stolen titanium and precious metal items that connect to this case.
lines.style: Procedural precision. Clipped, official phrasing. Each clause lands with equal weight. No elaboration—just what's being done. The voice of someone following protocol.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者を、本気for、絶対、引き寄せる、絶対、おとり捜査、絶対、警察、絶対、ご対応、絶対、ですか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Are you using undercover operations to draw the suspect out?
lines.style: Direct but deferential. Careful not to assume too much. Clear question, but delivered with slight uncertainty—acknowledging that he's outside his area of expertise. Leans on the interrogative lightly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。地域の、本気で、絶対、安全感を、絶対、押し上げる、絶対、よう、絶対、警察、絶対、巡回、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're strengthening police patrols throughout the area to raise the sense of safety in the community.
lines.style: Calm, authoritative reassurance. Slower pace on 'safety'—letting that word sit. The tone of someone explaining decisions that have already been made. Steady, not defensive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 近隣の、本気で、絶対、小国、絶対、と、絶対、警察、絶対、情報共有、絶対、進めていらっしゃるそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I see you're coordinating information with the neighboring prefectures as well, aren't you?
lines.style: Gentle observation phrased as a question. Recognition of effort already underway. Conversational confidence—he's understood what's happening. Soft acknowledgment rather than surprise.
